rows.guard: either slot is known future version
rows.action: reject mutation with version error, no repair write

rows.guard: no future version and either slot was not obtained in full
rows.action: loaded=0, IO error, reject ordinary mutation until explicit reload

rows.guard: both reads conclusive and at least one decoded valid
rows.action: use latest valid record, no boot repair write

rows.guard: conclusive reads but no decoded valid; not both absent
rows.action: no presets, preserve explicit repair semantics for fully read damaged data

load_gate_contract.boundary: No VM index, record format, save timing or automatic erase change. Complete CRC-invalid data can fall back to the other valid slot; an error/short return cannot prove unknown data safe to overwrite.
load_gate_contract.slot_classification_note: d injects SDK VM_DATA_LEN_ERR=-511; the unchanged GC9307 port maps it to ALARM_ERR_VERSION, so it is a known version-protected class, not an incomplete service read.
